content: Firefox does not support WXT's declarative content-script world:'MAIN' field; WXT's own docs/discussions recommend injecting the MAIN-world script manually via WXT's injectScript() helper (creates a <script src> element pointing at an unlisted script asset) for Firefox specifically, while Chrome supports the declarative world:'MAIN' field natively. Cross-browser parity requires branching this per-target in wxt.config.ts / the entrypoint definition.
